DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)

The platelet count, PT, and PTT are all within normal limits, which effectively rules out thrombocytopenia and most clotting factor deficiencies. Since the bleeding symptoms are present despite normal coagulation studies, I suspect an issue with the blood vessels themselves rather than the clotting mechanism. Do you or any family members have a history of easy bruising or similar bleeding issues at a young age?
